name: Let It Ride
description: Let It Ride is a popular casino table game based on five-card poker. Unlike traditional poker, players do not compete against each other or the dealer; instead, they play against a fixed paytable. The game is unique for its betting structure: players place three equal bets and have two opportunities to 'pull back' (withdraw) one of the bets if they don't like their cards, while 'letting it ride' if they have a strong potential hand.

content.text: Let It Ride is a popular casino table game based on five-card poker. Unlike traditional poker, players do not compete against each other or the dealer; instead, they play against a fixed paytable. The game is unique for its betting structure: players place three equal bets and have two opportunities to 'pull back' (withdraw) one of the bets if they don't like their cards, while 'letting it ride' if they have a strong potential hand.
Created by Shuffle Master (now Bally Technologies/Scientific Games) founder John Breeding in 1993. It was designed primarily to increase demand for the company's automatic card shufflers.
1-7 players each playing against the house. No player-vs-player competition.
Standard 52-card deck, shuffled after every hand (typically by automatic shuffler).
Specialized table with three betting circles per player: (1), (2), and ($). Also features a side bet area for Three Card Bonus.
Each player places three equal bets in the three betting circles. The ($) bet cannot be withdrawn; (1) and (2) can be pulled back during play.

items.text: Let It Ride Bonus: Adds a separate side bet for big hands with enhanced payouts.
Three Card Bonus: Optional side bet based solely on the player's first 3 cards, using Three Card Poker hand rankings.
Progressive Let It Ride: Linked jackpot variant where a small portion of each bet contributes to a progressive jackpot for rare hands (usually Royal Flush).
